nodes.label: Mobile Web Platform Split
nodes.rationale: Mobile Expo app handles physical QR scanning; Next.js web app handles management and dashboards.

nodes.label: TanStack Query and Zustand State Management
nodes.norm_label: tanstack query and zustand state management
nodes.rationale: TanStack Query manages server cache and mutation; Zustand manages local client state.

nodes.label: Two-Axis Code Review
nodes.rationale: Standards and Spec axes run in parallel sub-agents to avoid context pollution; reporting them separately prevents one axis from masking failures in the other.

nodes.label: System Boundary Mocking Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Mock only external system boundaries and avoid mocking internal collaborators to ensure tests remain decoupled from implementation details.

nodes.label: SDK-Style Interfaces for Mockability
nodes.rationale: Independent specific functions per external operation avoid conditional mocking logic and ensure clean type-safety per endpoint.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development Loop
nodes.rationale: TDD verifies behavior through public interfaces rather than implementation details; requires red before green, testing at pre-agreed seams, vertical slicing, and deferring refactoring to code review.

nodes.label: Test Seams
nodes.rationale: Testing only at agreed public boundaries prevents over-testing internals and focuses effort on critical paths.

nodes.label: Integration-Style Tests vs Implementation Details
nodes.rationale: Tests should verify observable behavior through public interfaces against independent known literals, rather than asserting on internal collaborator calls or recomputing expected values.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Rule
nodes.rationale: Consult graphify knowledge graph at graphify-out/ first for codebase and architecture questions to return scoped subgraphs much smaller than raw grep or full reports, and update after code modifications.

nodes.label: Governor Mobile Booth Access
nodes.rationale: Governors have administrative super-powers and may operate the mobile attendance booth.

nodes.label: Anonymized AI Reporting with Gemini
nodes.rationale: Gemini receives only aggregated, anonymized statistics for narrative reports without PII.

nodes.label: RTK Command Prefix Rule
nodes.rationale: Always prefix shell commands with rtk to minimize token consumption; cuts up to 90% of bash output before reaching LLM context.

nodes.label: Shared Event Ownership
nodes.rationale: Officers collaborate across shifts without per-officer event silo.

nodes.label: Late Registrants Full Semester Liability
nodes.rationale: Late onboarding students owe penalties for all events in the active semester to preserve clearance consistency.

nodes.label: Sentinel Attendance Timestamp
nodes.rationale: Manual attendance edits record sentinel timestamps to differentiate from physical QR scans.

nodes.label: Clerk Google SSO Domain Restriction
nodes.rationale: Restricts Google SSO via Clerk exclusively to school institutional domains.

nodes.label: Officer Direct Student Corrections
nodes.rationale: Officers can correct student ID and academic program during attendance desk checks.

nodes.label: On-Demand QR Card Pull Model
nodes.rationale: Students pull digital QR cards directly from dashboard rather than relying on email dispatch.

nodes.label: ADR-0001: Supabase, Drizzle, Turborepo, Vercel, and Expo Stack
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001: supabase, drizzle, turborepo, vercel, and expo stack
nodes.rationale: Selected Supabase (Postgres + Storage), Drizzle ORM, Turborepo monorepo, Vercel for web, and Expo for mobile booth tool to share schema and types across web and mobile while avoiding native toolchain overhead.

nodes.label: ADR-0002: shadcn/ui Design System from app.ncfccs.org
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: shadcn/ui design system from app.ncfccs.org
nodes.rationale: Adopt shadcn/ui with app.ncfccs.org design tokens for visual parity with sibling CCS Research Hub subdomain, using Geist Sans, Space Grotesk display headings, and next-themes dark mode; scoped strictly to apps/web.

nodes.label: ADR-0003: Password Auth Instead of Magic Link
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003: password auth instead of magic link
nodes.rationale: Replaced magic links with email+password for recurring gamification visits, rejecting 6-digit PIN due to weak keyspace; later superseded by Clerk Google SSO in ADR-0012.

nodes.label: ADR-0005: Client-Trusted Cached Session for Sidebar Navigation
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005: client-trusted cached session for sidebar navigation
nodes.rationale: Cache user identity in localStorage on sidebar mount to eliminate 3-5s navigation latency caused by dynamic server-side session revalidation on every click, while keeping server-side checks on all mutations and protected routes.

nodes.label: ADR-0004: Single-Day Events Instead of Date Ranges
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004: single-day events instead of date ranges
nodes.rationale: Multi-day activities are modeled as separate Event rows (one per calendar date) rather than date ranges to keep attendance_sessions schema simple and enable straightforward per-day penalty calculation.
